benchmark: TRUYN Semantic v2 Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B instruction-aware hard-pair diagnostic
instruction: Given the retrieval query, judge whether the authoritative document satisfies every material semantic constraint. The subject or domain, the required operational action, and the state/condition/scope must all match. If the document conflicts with any one material constraint, including the required action even when domain and condition match, judge it not relevant.
conclusion: Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B is rejected as the final v2 reranker. The instruction-aware yes/no probabilities were highly saturated for both expected and wrong near-duplicate passages and neither original nor canonical query path reached 3/3. No corpus-wide run is justified.
